name: 001 - Lactate
title: Lactate

name: 002 - Pyruvate
title: Pyruvate

name: 003 - Glucose

name: 005 - Starch
title: Starch

name: 006 - Fatty Acid

title: Triglyceride

name: 009 - Adipose Tissue

name: 010 - Fat

name: 024 - Dissolved carbon dioxide

name: 025 - Urea

name: 026 - Ammonia

name: 029 - Air

name: 033 - Water

name: 036 - ADP
